name: Deadly Finesse III
description:
Tries to avoid traps first and always rolls with dexterity. If successful, the trap is disarmed.
On hit, apply 60 charges of BLEED.
+10% dodge (additive)
+100% Attack Speed
-50% Basic Attack Damage

BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
